column2: [intro]
My name is Momo, the king of ambiguity,
I stroll through life with no clear reality.
I take everything lightly, I’m a true nut,
With me, people are lost, but that’s the fun part.
Ambiguity is my creed,
I’m the clown of the strange, making kids laugh with glee.
With my craziness, I create emotions,
Ambiguity, it’s my devotion.
In my closet, I don’t care about gender,
I dress up as an owl, or a ballerina’s splendor.
Whether male or female, it’s all the same,
I mix up styles, that’s what fuels my flame.
Ambiguity is my creed,
I’m the clown of the strange, making kids laugh with glee.
With my craziness, I create emotions,
Ambiguity, it’s my devotion.
